name: Hand of Iruxos
summary: At Shadowprey Village, Taiga Wisemane sends you to Thunder Axe Fortress for a Demon Box. The Burning Blade uses the Hand of Iruxos inside it to open portals for demons at Mannoroc Coven.

sections.title: The Box in the Fortress
sections.body: Taiga Wisemane wants the demons' passage into our world stopped. She gives you a demon pick for the red crystal inside Thunder Axe Fortress. Use it to reach the Demon Box, then bring the box and pick back to Taiga in Shadowprey Village.

faq.q: Who asks for the Demon Box?
faq.answer: Taiga Wisemane asks you for the Demon Box in Shadowprey Village.

faq.q: What is the Hand of Iruxos?
faq.answer: The Hand of Iruxos is a powerful thing kept inside the Demon Box. At Mannoroc Coven, the Burning Blade uses it to open portals for demons.
The Demon Box lies in Thunder Axe Fortress, beyond a red crystal.

faq.q: How do you get to the Demon Box?
faq.answer: Taiga gives you a demon pick to use on the red crystal inside Thunder Axe Fortress.
